Marginal supplier joins the capex wave: Nanya raises 2026 capex 34% (NT$52B to NT$69.7B) and approves up to NT$346.6B (~$10.7B) for Fab 5A through 2029 targeting 10nm-class EUV DRAM — funded by July revenue of NT$43.9B (+720% yoy, 9th straight record; Q2 ASP +60% qoq on flat bits, GM 79.5%). The supply response the top-signature watches is now visible beyond the big three

Korea Aug 1-10: semis $9.95B (+155.4%) = 46.8% of ALL Korean exports (+20.1pp yoy) — memory approaching half the national export book; total $21.29B (+45.3%) best-ever August start on identical 7v7 working days, surpassing 2022 record of $15.6B

Taiwan July orders: 18th consecutive yoy gain, record $97.94B (+61.9%); electronics $41.32B (+71.7%, decelerating from June +79.9%) while ICT +89.5% leads on servers; MOEA guides August $97-99B — the forward order book still steepening into H2
